suggested_use: Current 18mm HDMI software reference for parameter parsing, inverse mapping and bilinear integration; final optical deployment requires independent fixed-focus verification.

video.coordinate_policy: Native H.264 decoded raster, x right / y down; no scaling, cropping or perspective correction before fitting.

target.square_source: User measured five squares = 95mm; equality of horizontal and vertical print scale is unconfirmed.
target.mounting_evidence: Confirmed by user during the preceding capture on 2026-10-22.

mapping_sanity_check.note: Sampled analytic local Jacobian, with P=K. Positive samples are a sanity check, not a global accuracy certificate.

limitations: Held-out residual and line straightness improve modestly; they do not establish absolute physical correction accuracy.
Time-block estimates disagree in source maps, including in their common observed source region; constant full-frame parameters are not independently validated.
Whole-area AF describes an AF area and does not establish movie-servo state or a locked focus position.
Different time blocks have different poses, coverage, sample counts and residuals; map disagreement cannot be attributed to AF from these data.
Image corners are less constrained than the center; the lower-right image corner has the weakest direct corner observations.
Validation views share a recording session and use their own corners for pose estimation; this is not an independent acquisition or known-ground-truth accuracy test.
OBS applies no spatial transform in this recording; internal camera/capture-card processing is not established by that fact.
No MTF50/SFR, hardware timing or FPGA resource measurements were performed in this calibration step.
